# Aixuno

Aixuno is a free, browser-based Markdown and AI content conversion platform. Content is processed locally without uploading files to an Aixuno application server.

## Default English tools

- Markdown to Word: /tools/markdown-to-word.html
- Markdown to PDF: /tools/markdown-to-pdf.html
- Markdown to HTML: /tools/markdown-to-html.html
- Office files to Markdown: /tools/excel-to-markdown.html

## Language versions

- English: /
- Simplified Chinese: /zh/
- Spanish: /es/
- German: /de/
- Japanese: /ja/
- French: /fr/

Each language homepage contains working Markdown to Word, Markdown to PDF, Markdown to HTML, and office-file-to-Markdown workflows.

## English guides

- Export ChatGPT answers to Word: /guides/chatgpt-to-word.html
- Convert DeepSeek answers to Word: /guides/deepseek-to-word.html
- Excel and CSV to Markdown: /guides/excel-to-markdown-guide.html
- Choose an export format for AI content: /guides/how-to-export-ai-answer.html

## Chinese content

- Chinese homepage: /zh/
- Chinese Markdown to WeChat formatter: /zh/tools/wechat-format.html
- Chinese guides: /zh/guides/

## Supported AI content sources

The international versions are designed for content from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, Grok, and other assistants. The Chinese version additionally covers DeepSeek, Doubao, Tencent Yuanbao, Qwen, and ERNIE Bot.
